get.summary: List Field Rules for an Asset Type (Project Scope)
get.description: Returns the project inheritance overlay of company FIELD_DEFAULTS plus project overrides for the given asset type. Each row includes an {@code overridden} flag. Returns an empty list when the asset type is hidden on the project. The {@code project_id} path variable is required for project-level permission resolution.

parameters.name: asset_type_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the asset type.

parameters.name: rule_types
parameters.description: Optional repeatable rule-type filter (e.g. rule_type=MANDATORY&rule_type=WARNING). When provided, takes precedence over the single rule_type param.

parameters.name: fieldset_id
parameters.description: Optional fieldset id filter ("-1" for Procore defaults)

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Locale for localized response messages (for example: en, fr-FR, pseudo)

id.description: Unique identifier of the field rule

project_id.description: Project this rule applies to; null for company-level rules

asset_type_id.description: Asset type this rule applies to. Populated for FIELD_DEFAULTS; null for NAMING.

fieldset_id.description: Fieldset scope. '-1' for Procore default fields, external configurable fieldset id for custom fields. Null for NAMING.

trigger_field.description: Field that triggers this rule (e.g. asset_code for NAMING, custom_field_1234 for FIELD_DEFAULTS)

definition.description: Structured rule definition. Shape depends on ruleType: FieldRuleDefinitionDTO for NAMING, FieldDefaultsDefinitionDTO for FIELD_DEFAULTS, ConditionalValidationDefinitionDTO for MANDATORY/WARNING.

field.description: For REF: field identifier from Constants.NAMING_FIELDS (e.g. project, asset_type_id)

fallback.description: For REF: fallback when field value is null or empty

skip_if_empty.description: For REF: when true, omit this segment (and collapse delimiters) if the resolved value is empty instead of using fallback. Mutually exclusive with fallback. Default false.

digits.description: For SEQ: number of digits for padding (e.g. 3 -> 001)

start_value.description: For SEQ: optional starting sequence number

actions.description: Non-empty list of actions to apply. Must include exactly one SET_DEFAULT; SET_READ_ONLY is optional and appears at most once.

items.description: A single action inside a field rule definition

value.description: Action value. For SET_DEFAULT: matches the Asset custom_fields storage format (String/Number/Boolean for primitives, {id, name} for reference types). For SET_READ_ONLY: Boolean true/false.

data_type.description: FieldType key (required for SET_DEFAULT; null for SET_READ_ONLY)

message.description: Optional message (reserved for future action types like SET_REQUIRED)

oneOf.description: Rule definition for MANDATORY/WARNING rules (optional custom message)

message.description: Optional custom validation message shown when the rule fires

conditions.description: Conditions AST for a conditional-validation rule

root.description: Root node of the recursive conditions tree

rule_group_id.description: Group id linking granular rules authored from one admin UI row. Null when ungrouped.

is_active.description: Whether the rule is active and applied; false to deactivate without deleting

validation_errors.description: Validation issues detected on this rule. Null when the rule is valid; a non-empty list otherwise.

items.description: Validation issue detected on a field rule at read time.

code.description: Code identifying the class of issue.

effect.description: Description of the impact of this issue.

remedy.description: Guidance on how an admin can resolve the issue.

overridden.description: Project-scope overlay indicator. Populated only in the project-scoped list view: true when a project rule overrides the company configuration for this field (value and/or editability differs, or no company rule exists); false when the row is inherited from the company with no project override. Null in company-scoped responses.

400.description: The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax or parameters that fail to meet validation requirements.

401.description: Although the HTTP standard specifies "unauthorized", semantically this response means "unauthenticated". That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.

403.description: The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is authenticated, but the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401, the client's identity is known to the server.

404.description: The server can not find the requested resource. This can mean either the URL is not recognized, or the resource itself does not exist. Servers may also send this response instead of 403 to hide the existence of a resource from an unauthorized client.

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("localhost:8080")

headers = {
    'Procore-Company-Id': "SOME_INTEGER_VALUE",
    'Accept-Language': "SOME_STRING_VALUE"
    }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/1234/projects/1234/assets/settings/asset_types/%7Basset_type_id%7D/field_rules?rule_type=SOME_STRING_VALUE&rule_types=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&fieldset_id=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
